sentences.japanese: 君は疲れているようだから、休んだ方がよい。
sentences.english: Since you look tired, you had better take a rest.

sentences.japanese: 君は疲れているので、休んだ方がよい。
sentences.english: Now that you are tired, you'd better rest.

sentences.japanese: 疲れてるみたいだね。１時間か２時間、休んだ方がいいよ。
sentences.english: You look tired. You ought to rest for an hour or two.

sentences.japanese: 君は少し休んだほうがよい。
sentences.english: You had better take a little rest.
